correctness.rationale: Every serial root in any Euclidean frame has nonempty C=R(r) included in T=R²(r), with R(x)=T for x∈T. Structural induction makes arbitrary one-variable formula truth depend on root p and the ordered C/T existential/universal pattern, giving five successor patterns times two root values; a dead end supplies two more. Six modal tests define each of twelve signatures, yielding exactly 2^12=4096 one-generated classes. A finite five-world witness plus normality and union preservation makes the induced set function singleton-generated; automorphism symmetry and indistinguishable valuations {c1} versus {c1,u1} force γ≤β, leaving three successor options and two independent root/dead options, hence precisely 12 additive operators Eε∨Hα∨Bj. Each preserves arbitrary unions on all frames. Independently 354 Euclidean frames up to size 4 and 5240 valuations and representative separation checked; this finite test does NOT establish the unbounded induction.
